Originally worked as a Circus Clown. |id = BONZO_1, MASTER_BONZO_1 }} '''Bonzo''' is the {{boss}} of [[Catacombs - Floor I]] of [[The Catacombs]] Dungeon. == Collection == Killing Bonzo levels up the Bonzo Collection. {{CollectionTable|Bonzo}} {{/Collection UI}} == The Fight == === First Phase === Bonzo will continually summon {{MobSprite|Undead (Bonzo);Undead}}s, and run around attacking players with wither skulls during his first phase. Bonzo holds the [[Dark Orb]] during the first phase. Bonzo has {{Stat|Health|250,000}} and will move on to the second phase once players have killed his first phase. === Second Phase === Bonzo revives during his second phase, healing himself back to his max health and gaining '''Default Attack''' and '''Balloon Barrage'''. === Arena === Bonzo's arena is open in the center but has 7 different short pillars close to the edges. It heavily resembles a Circus arena, and Bonzo's first phase can go on top of the pillars. In his second phase, Bonzo's Balloon Barrage attack can aim his balloons on top of the pillars, meaning the only way to defend yourself against the attack is to either dodge the balloons yourself or hide behind a pillar. [[File:Bonzo Arena.png|thumb|334x334px]] == Attacks == * '''Default Attack '''- Strikes the player in melee range for damage. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the second phase. * '''Wither Skull '''- Bonzo fires a Wither Skull at a player dealing {{Stat|Damage|1,598}}. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the first phase. **In Master Mode, Bonzo shoots Wither Skulls more quickly. * '''Bonzo's Balloon '''- Bonzo fires a balloon at a player, dealing {{Stat|Damage|1,598}} in normal mode and {{Stat|Damage|22,500}} in [[Master Mode]]. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the second phase. ** This move is identical to '''Wither Skull'''. **In Master Mode, he tends to shoot his balloons at an upward angle. * '''Balloon Barrage '''- Bonzo moves to the center of the arena before unleashing a barrage of balloons around him in all directions. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the second phase. * '''Summon Undead'''- Bonzo will summon some {{MobSprite|Undead (Bonzo);Undead}}s to attack the player. The Undeads only have {{Stat|Health|45,000}} and act like regular Zombies. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the first phase. == Master Mode Changes == * Bonzo has {{Hp|200M}} and his Undeads have {{Hp|15M}}. * Bonzo spawns Undeads more frequently in his 1st phase. * The Wither Skull and Balloon attacks deal {{Stat|Damage|22,500}}. == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Bonzo}} == Drops == Killing '''Bonzo''' in both phase one and two directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 221-756 |coins = 552-1,890 |combat_xp = 1,657-5,670 |orbs = 663-2,268 }} Defeating him in phase two will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor I/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor I/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 221 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor I]] |health = 250,000 |damage = 2,664 |coins = 552 |combat_xp = 1,657 |orbs = 663 |id = BONZO_1 |level2 = 756 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor I|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor I]] |health2 = 200,000,000 |damage2 = 45,000 |coins2 = 1,890 |combat_xp2 = 5,670 |orbs2 = 2,268 |id2 = MASTER_BONZO_1 }} == Trivia == * Bonzo's second phase's design is based on the main antagonist Pennywise, the Dancing Clown from ''It. '' ** Bonzo's first phase's skin was a skin the admin Likaos had. * If every player in the dungeon has already completed Floor I before, or in Master Floor 1, he will just say "Oh I'm dead! Sike." when transitioning to phase two. * The music playing in the background of the boss fight is Superior Judgement from the Hypixel Noteblock Song Competition 2020. * Bonzo can reappear as a spirit [[The Watcher]] summons on the 3rd, 4th, and 5th Floor. * Bonzo's line "You fools! You fell victim to one of the classic blunders!" is a reference to Vizzini from ''The Princess Bride.'' * The item Bonzo holds in his first phase appears to be a [[Dark Orb]]. * Bonzo gets the most references by characters in the Catacombs. Every boss up to Floor 4, excluding [[The Professor]], has at least 1 thing to do with Bonzo. **[[The Watcher]] brings him back as an Undead. ** [[Scarf]] has a line that says "I can't believe Bonzo lost to someone so weak!" ** Some members of [[Thorn|Thorn's]] audience will say "Avenge Bonzo! #RememberBonzo" or "Remember Bonzo! #NeverForget" * Bonzo had a optifine cape displaying the non-binary flag design. *When Bonzo is summoned as an Undead is defeated, it doesn't add to the collection. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Start |{{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] &cBonzo&f: Gratz for making it this far, but I’m basically unbeatable. &4[BOSS] &cBonzo&f: I don't even need to fight, this is the life! &4[BOSS] &cBonzo&f: I can summon lots of undead!
